relations.description: UE transitions from 5GMM-CONNECTED to 5GMM-CONNECTED with RRC inactive upon RRC suspension indication.
UE transitions back to 5GMM-CONNECTED upon indication of transition to RRC_CONNECTED state.
UE transitions to 5GMM-IDLE mode upon various triggers including PLMN selection, fallback indication, or RRC resume failure.
RRC suspension indication establishes 5GMM-CONNECTED with RRC inactive state.
RRC connected indication re-establishes normal 5GMM-CONNECTED state.
Fallback indication triggers transition to 5GMM-IDLE mode.
Selection of non-equivalent PLMN triggers transition to 5GMM-IDLE mode.
AMF paging indication triggers transition to 5GMM-IDLE mode.
Registration procedure uses 5GS update type IE with NG-RAN-RCU bit.
Service request procedure uses UE request type IE.
Service request procedure may include Uplink data status IE.
RRC resume failure triggers registration procedure for connection recovery.
